question: Under what condition should a teacher bestow the life-giving teaching upon a disciple?
premises: The candidate must be thoroughly examined
Examination should be done always or carefully
Only then may the teacher give it
inference: After thorough examination, the teacher may give the long-life teaching to him.
uncertainties: cirajīvitam may mean long life or a teaching conferring it
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one who gives should bestow long life upon him.
